title: What are team-managed and company-managed projects
content:
Spaces in Jira can be created as either team-managed or company-managed. The core functionality of these are the same, but there are key differences you should know in order to decide what’s right for your team.
To see whether you’re in a team-managed or company-managed space, select More actions () next to the space's name in the header. Or, next to your space's name in the sidebar, select More actions (), then at the bottom of that menu that opens, you’ll be able to view whether your space is:
- Team-managed
- Company-managed
Team-managed spaces
Set up and maintained by anyone on the team, team-managed spaces are ideal for autonomous teams who want to control their own working processes and practices in a self-contained space. Team-managed spaces have simpler space configuration and give space admins more control over setup without involving a Jira admin (unlike company-managed spaces, where one is required to configure schemes and screens).
Choose a team-managed space if:
- Your team wants easier space configuration to get started quickly.
- You want a self-contained space to manage your team’s work.
Company-managed spaces
Set up and maintained by Jira admins, company-managed spaces are the best choice for teams who want to work with other teams across many spaces in a standard way, such as sharing a workflow.
Company-managed spaces require a Jira admin to configure screens and schemes that spaces are based on. This means that company-managed spaces have greater complexity in space configuration, but also the ability to standardize workflows across spaces that team-managed spaces don’t have. When a Jira admin changes a scheme or screen, every company-managed space that uses that configuration changes accordingly.
Choose a company-managed space if you:
- want to standardize configuration across multiple spaces in your organization.
- want complex customization for permissions and workflows.
